description: Use this to know who a Chilean securities issuer is: legal name, status, stock ticker, address, board of directors (role in English, date of the latest election: re-elected directors show it too, see board_dates_note), executives, the 12 largest shareholders with their ownership and the controlling shareholder when one holds more than half, plus a brief on its sales to the Chilean State. Pass rut (e.g. 61.808.000-5; dots, dash and check digit optional). Read from the CMF registry, cached a day, with a source_url per section. Personal ID numbers are left out. Access: open to anonymous agents (rate-limited); a free AndesPass key raises the limit.

rut.description: The company's RUT (Chilean tax id), e.g. 61.808.000-5; dots, dash and check digit optional.
rut.title: Rut
